paragraphs.en: A skill for your coding assistant that stops it from burying the answer. Action first. Steps numbered. No "Hope this helps!"
paragraphs.zh: 一个给你的编程助手的技能，防止它把答案埋没。行动优先。步骤编号。不要「希望这有帮助！」

paragraphs.en: Kacper Rutkiewicz | AI Made Simple has made a good breakdown of an earlier version of the skill.
paragraphs.zh: Kacper Rutkiewicz | AI Made Simple 对该技能的早期版本做了一个很好的拆解分析。

paragraphs.en: Great question! Let me think about this. Your auth flow has a few moving pieces: the middleware, the token verification, and the cookie handling. Looking at src/auth.ts , the verifyToken function (around lines 42-58) seems to be using an older jsonwebtoken API. One approach would be to update the package and rewrite that function. After making the change, you'd want to run the auth tests to confirm nothing breaks. By the way, you might also want to look at your dependency versions overall. Hope this helps! Let me know if you want to dig deeper.
paragraphs.zh: 好问题！让我想想。 你的身份验证流程有几个组成部分：中间件、令牌验证以及 Cookie 处理。 看了一下 src/auth.ts，verifyToken 函数（大约在第 42-58 行）似乎在使用旧版的 jsonwebtoken API。 一种做法是更新该依赖包并重写这个函数。 做出修改后，你需要运行身份验证相关的测试，确认没有破坏任何功能。 顺便说一句，你可能还想整体检查一下你的依赖版本。希望这些对你有帮助！ 如果你想深入了解，请告诉我。

sents.en: Great question! Let me think about this.
Your auth flow has a few moving pieces: the middleware, the token verification, and the cookie handling.
sents.zh: 你的身份验证流程有几个组成部分：中间件、令牌验证以及 Cookie 处理。

sents.en: Looking at src/auth.ts , the verifyToken function (around lines 42-58) seems to be using an older jsonwebtoken API.
sents.zh: 看了一下 src/auth.ts，verifyToken 函数（大约在第 42-58 行）似乎在使用旧版的 jsonwebtoken API。

sents.en: One approach would be to update the package and rewrite that function.
sents.zh: 一种做法是更新该依赖包并重写这个函数。

sents.en: After making the change, you'd want to run the auth tests to confirm nothing breaks.
sents.zh: 做出修改后，你需要运行身份验证相关的测试，确认没有破坏任何功能。

sents.en: By the way, you might also want to look at your dependency versions overall. Hope this helps!
sents.zh: 顺便说一句，你可能还想整体检查一下你的依赖版本。希望这些对你有帮助！

sents.en: Let me know if you want to dig deeper.
sents.zh: 如果你想深入了解，请告诉我。

paragraphs.en: Edit src/auth.ts:42 to update the token validation.
paragraphs.zh: 编辑 src/auth.ts:42 以更新令牌验证。

paragraphs.en: Next: paste the first failing line if any test fails.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步：如有任何测试失败，请粘贴第一行失败的输出。

paragraphs.en: Fork, edit skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md , then swap your copy in:
paragraphs.zh: 克隆仓库，编辑 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md ，然后替换为你自己的版本：

paragraphs.en: claude plugin uninstall i-have-adhd # drop the upstream copy first: claude plugin marketplace remove i-have-adhd # fork and upstream share both names claude plugin marketplace add < your-username > /i-have-adhd claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd Restart your coding assistant, then re-invoke /i-have-adhd .
paragraphs.zh: claude plugin uninstall i-have-adhd # 先删除上游副本： claude plugin marketplace remove i-have-adhd # fork 和上游共享相同的名称 claude plugin marketplace add < your-username > /i-have-adhd claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd 重启你的编程助手，然后重新调用 /i-have-adhd 。

paragraphs.en: Loosely based on The Adult ADHD Tool Kit by J. Russell Ramsay and Anthony L. Rostain. Adapted for how an LLM should respond, not how a human should organize their day.
paragraphs.zh: 内容大致基于 J. 拉塞尔·拉姆齐（Russell Ramsay）和安东尼·L·罗斯坦（Anthony L. Rostain）合著的《成人多动症工具包》。 已改编为大语言模型应如何回应的版本，而非人类应如何安排一天。
